MOUSE ESPRESSO - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft).
Code MIT; art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

Run MouseEspresso.exe. No installation or extra DLLs needed.
HOLD X or Z (also C, V, Up), or a gamepad face button, to rise on steam.
RELEASE to coast and fall. You can safely run on the counter and fly to the top
of the screen. Avoid stools, hanging shelves, appliances, snapping mousetraps,
cat paws and toast. Toasters launch two tumbling slices that fall to either side.
Collect biscuits: each adds 5 points; each metre travelled adds 1.
One life, an endless café, a best score to beat. Travel and toast speed increase
with distance. Watch the toaster lights and trap glints for warning.

A / X starts from the position displayed on the title. Hold to thrust.
Enter starts, pauses and resumes.
Backspace / Esc / Right Shift also pause. After results, A returns to the title.
Players 2-4 join with A on the title and leave with B. P1 starts the game.
Everyone shares one screen, with spaced positions and coloured packs/scarves.
P2 keyboard: H / G to thrust, T Start, R Select. W also thrusts.
Gamepads work for up to four players.
F11 or Alt+Enter toggles fullscreen. F12 takes a screenshot.
Watch for cat paws: a visible 1.2-second peek and three harmless tentative
movements precede the fast swat, then a full retreat.
Espresso machines and kettles emit timed steam bursts. Mixers spin four blades.
Long tables leave routes above and below their tops; the rear legs are behind
the flight lane. Biscuit trails help you choose a route. Moving hazards speed
up gradually, with room between obstacles to change height.
Best scores are saved to mouseespresso.srm next to the executable.
